extraction.document_summary: AIA HealthShield Gold Max is an AIA integrated shield plan (MediShield Life plus an additional private insurance coverage portion) designed to cover hospitalisation and many related inpatient/outpatient costs. It is offered with three plan tiers for ward entitlements: Max A (private standard ward or lower), Max B (A-class ward or lower), and Max B Lite (4-bedder or B1-class ward or lower). The brochure states high limits including “up to S$2 million per year” and “unlimited lifetime claim amount”, plus “guaranteed lifetime coverage.” Key mechanics include deductibles and co-insurance for eligible hospital bills and extended pre-/post-hospitalisation coverage (up to 13 months before/after hospitalisation, subject to the plan type). It also adds outpatient cancer benefits and a separate “extra cover for 30 critical illnesses per policy year” (up to S$100,000 for Max A; S$75,000 Max B; S$50,000 Max B Lite). A material caveat is that certain benefits are payable only on the plan’s stated ward/conditions (e.g., overseas treatment and specific outpatient limits) and the brochure notes that some exclusions apply (full list in policy contracts).
quality_notes: Brochure provides extensive benefit tables and explicit numeric limits by plan tier (Max A / Max B / Max B Lite and Standard plan for public hospitals).
Riders/add-ons are explicitly named as “add-on” (AIA Max VitalHealth Pro) and “Optional” add-ons within it (Cancer Care Pro, Emergency Care Pro).
Some underwriting/eligibility fields (entry age range, residency requirements, occupation classes, underwriting method) are not stated.
Some coverage mechanics reference footnotes (pre-existing conditions, pro-ration, deductible/co-insurance structure), but do not fully quantify every scenario in this brochure excerpt.
No explicit premium amounts are provided; premium-related fields are mostly described qualitatively (e.g., “no premium increase after claims”, “premium capped/co-payment” for add-on).

policies.quick_summary: AIA HealthShield Gold Max is an Integrated Shield Plan (MediShield Life + AIA private insurance portion) with “guaranteed lifetime coverage” and “unlimited lifetime claim amount.” It is sold in ward-entitlement tiers (Max A / Max B / Max B Lite) and is structured around hospitalisation and surgical benefits with pre- and post-hospitalisation coverage (including up to 13 months before/after hospitalisation depending on plan and admission context). It also includes specified inpatient extras (e.g., hospice inpatient palliative care, psychiatric treatment, pregnancy complications and congenital abnormalities subject to waiting periods) and outpatient benefits such as cancer-related treatments. A key limitation noted is that some benefits are only payable when conditions are met (e.g., overseas arrangement, and the brochure states certain psychiatric-related diagnoses make these benefits not payable).
coverage_scope: Inpatient psychiatric treatment and post-hospitalisation psychiatric treatment
Outpatient benefits including radiotherapy/renal dialysis/erythropoietin/immunosuppressants/long-term parenteral nutrition and cancer treatment items
Waiver of one year’s premium upon total and permanent disability
Extra cover for 30 critical illnesses per policy year
Medical treatment outside Singapore benefits (subject to conditions)
Cell, tissue and gene therapy and Proton beam therapy (as stated in the benefit tables)
Outpatient and home-based treatments such as NPWT/rTMS/PDHM/HBOT/OPAT/home ventilation and respiratory support (as stated)
important_caveats: Premiums are not guaranteed; the insurer may review/increase with age upon renewal (as stated in Terms and Conditions).
Some benefits have waiting periods (e.g., pregnancy complications and congenital abnormalities, living donor organ transplant).
The brochure states that certain psychiatric-condition diagnoses make related benefits not payable.
Pro-ration may apply for private hospital bills or public hospital A/B1-class ward bills under MediShield Life (noted in the brochure note).
Value-added services (e.g., Teladoc/AIA Vitality partner services) are not contractual insurance benefits and may be withdrawn (general note).

It covers/offsets co-insurance incurred under AIA HealthShield Gold Max and/or Cancer Care Pro, adds an immediate family accommodation benefit, post-hospitalisation alternative medicine and home nursing, home palliative care, non-listed cell/tissue/gene therapy, and early detection screening (colonoscopy and mammogram) plus Teladoc personal medical case management.

review_notes: VitalHealth Pro is treated as an add-on/rider to the base integrated shield plan per the brochure wording (“AIA Max VitalHealth Pro … Add-on”).

Where the brochure provides multiple different benefit tables (e.g., ‘Benefits of AIA HealthShield Gold Max Standard Plan’), the extraction captures the explicitly named ‘Standard plan’ as a separate plan option to avoid collapsing distinct tier tables.

Some numeric deductible/co-insurance figures are shown in the ‘Standard plan’ tables; deductible/co-insurance mechanics for Max A/B/B Lite are described but not fully quantified for every ward class in this excerpt.
